Dealer's choice,' so that stale fragment was not trusted as current. San Diego Magazine references a food menu (dry-aged steaks, housemade pastas, lobster truffle mac'n'cheese) but no priced source for it was found on any platform. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub presence (reservation-only venue, not delivery). Blocked rather than not_found since the business is clearly open and active (recent reviews/reservations); blocked rather than found since no discoverable priced item list exists.
